records.title: TextSeal: A Localized LLM Watermark for Provenance & Distillation Protection
records.reason: TextSeal is a decoding-time watermark using dual-key Gumbel-max sampling and entropy-weighted localized detection; it claims zero inference overhead and compatibility with speculative decoding, but the contribution is provenance protection rather than an inference-system improvement, so it stays borderline.

records.title: PUMA: Layer-Pruned Language Model for Efficient Unified Multimodal Retrieval with Modality-Adaptive Learning
records.reason: PUMA prunes MLLM layers with self-distillation to cut inference cost, but the target task is unified multimodal retrieval and the pruning is tied to retrieval quality rather than a general LLM serving or decoding mechanism, so the inference-system contribution is indirect.

records.title: LUT-APP: Dynamic-Precision LUT-based Approximation Unifying Non-Linear Operations in Transformers
records.reason: LUT-APP unifies dynamic-precision LUT piecewise-linear approximation for transformer non-linear ops (EXP, GeLU, SiLU, reciprocal) that bottleneck on-device inference latency; a direct hardware approximation contribution to transformer inference execution.

records.title: CIVIC: End-to-End Sequence Compactness for Efficient Vision-Language Models
records.reason: CIVIC keeps visual token sequences compact contiguously across the vision encoder, projection, LLM prefill and KV cache, removing post-hoc pruning overhead and yielding wall-clock VLM inference acceleration; a direct inference memory/latency contribution.

records.title: Retrofitting Temporal Graph Neural Networks with Transformer
records.reason: TF-TGN reuses a Transformer decoder codebase as the backbone for temporal graph neural networks to simplify TGNN training frameworks; the subject is graph learning, with no LLM inference mechanism or serving contribution.

records.title: Neural Comprehension: Language Models with Compiled Neural Networks
records.reason: Neural Comprehension inserts compiled neural network modules with artificially generated attention weights into transformers to encode explicit rules for symbolic reasoning; a capability/architecture proposal with no inference efficiency or serving content.

records.title: A 65.1 TOPS/W Digital CIM Processor for Ultra-Low-Bit Transformers with Multiplexer-based Adder and Scaling Factor-based Reordering
records.reason: This ISCAS paper designs a digital compute-in-memory processor for binarized ultra-low-bit transformers with a multiplexer-based adder and scaling-factor reordering, directly attacking LLM inference energy and memory-access costs in hardware.

records.title: Cost-Efficiency Frameworks for Scaling Large Language Models in Real-World Systems
records.reason: This paper surveys and compares cost-efficiency frameworks for scaling LLMs across optimization, hardware-aware deployment and resource allocation, but proposes no concrete inference mechanism or measured serving system, so it remains a borderline overview.

records.title: 4LM: Local Lightweight LLMs for Image Captioning on Embedded Systems
records.reason: 4LM deploys quantized lightweight LLMs for image captioning on Raspberry-Pi-class embedded hardware; quantization is used as an off-the-shelf deployment step for a captioning application rather than a new inference technique, hence borderline.

records.title: Think Less, Know More: State-Aware Reasoning Compression with Knowledge Guidance for Efficient Reasoning
records.reason: STACK performs step-wise chain-of-thought compression with stage-specific state awareness and knowledge guidance, directly reducing reasoning tokens and inference latency of large reasoning models; a concrete decoding-time efficiency method.

records.title: Low Latency GNN Accelerator for Quantum Error Correction
records.reason: Title explicitly limits the work to a GNN accelerator for quantum error correction decoding, a quantum-computing application domain, with no LLM or language-model inference subject in the title.

records.title: CCL-D: A High-Precision Diagnostic System for Slow and Hang Anomalies in Large-Scale Model Training
records.reason: CCL-D diagnoses slow and hang anomalies in collective communication during large-scale model training; it is training-infrastructure diagnostics, not inference serving or decoding, and gives no inference-system contribution.

records.title: DRetHTR: Linear-Time Decoder-Only Retentive Network for Handwritten Text Recognition
records.reason: Title explicitly limits the work to handwritten text recognition, a document/OCR application, even though the named network is decoder-only; no general LLM inference subject is stated in the title.

records.title: rMuscle: Robotic Muscle Memory for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Inference
records.reason: rMuscle exploits repetitive embodied workloads to accelerate vision-language-action model inference for factory robots; the framework targets VLA policy latency in a robotics setting, adjacent to but not an LLM inference system contribution, so borderline.

records.title: MegTaiChi: dynamic tensor-based memory management optimization for DNN training
records.reason: MegTaiChi optimizes DNN training memory by combining dynamic tensor partition and rematerialization under limited GPU memory; the objective is training larger models, with no inference execution contribution.

records.title: Enhancing RAG Efficiency with Adaptive Context Compression
records.reason: ACC-RAG adaptively sets context compression rates by input complexity for retrieval-augmented generation, directly reducing the lengthy retrieved-context inference cost of LLM generation while preserving accuracy; a concrete inference-efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Auto-MAP: A DQN Framework for Exploring Distributed Execution Plans for DNN Workloads
records.reason: Auto-MAP uses a DQN to search distributed execution plans that parallelize DNN training workloads across devices; it addresses training parallelization, not inference serving or decoding efficiency.

records.title: Distributed Collaborative Inference System in Next-Generation Networks and Communication
records.reason: This paper proposes a distributed collaborative inference system for generative AI over next-generation 6G networks, but at a conceptual network-architecture level without a concrete LLM serving mechanism or measured inference pipeline, so borderline.

records.title: Accelerating LatentSync Lip-Synchronization via OmniQuant-Inspired Post-Training Quantization
records.reason: An OmniQuant-inspired post-training quantization is applied to the LatentSync lip-synchronization diffusion model for real-time deployment; quantization of a non-LLM application model, with the inference contribution tied to that application, hence borderline.

records.title: Fine-Grained State Sharding and Communication Pipelining for Partially Sharded Data Parallelism
records.reason: Fine-grained state sharding and communication pipelining improve partially sharded data parallelism, but the target is data-parallel training throughput and GPU memory in training, not inference.

records.title: TokaDB: A Unified Storage Engine for Training-Serving Data Management in Large Recommendation Models
records.reason: TokaDB is a storage engine for the training-serving data lifecycle of large recommendation models, handling behavior-sequence access and KV-cache-like data at exabyte scale; serving-adjacent data management for recommender models rather than LLM inference, so borderline.

records.title: FlashFPS: Efficient Farthest Point Sampling for Large-Scale Point Clouds via Pruning and Caching
records.reason: FlashFPS prunes and caches farthest point sampling to cut inference latency in point-based neural networks for 3D point clouds; a geometry-processing operator optimization outside LLM inference systems.

records.title: Tiara: A Programmable Line-Rate ISA for Remote Memory Access
records.reason: Tiara defines a programmable line-rate ISA for remote memory access that resolves data-dependent indirection in one round trip, citing disaggregated LLM inference KV-cache resolution among several patterns; promising memory infrastructure but not LLM-inference-specific, so borderline.

records.title: Reservoir of Importance: Learning Semi-Structured Sparsity with Differentiable Subset Sampling
records.reason: Reservoir of Importance learns semi-structured N:M sparsity masks for LLMs via differentiable subset sampling with low overhead, directly enabling structured-sparse LLM inference acceleration; a concrete pruning contribution for inference.

records.title: Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
records.reason: Dynamics-aware sparse attention allocates computation to moving regions in autoregressive video diffusion transformers to cut their heavy compute and memory; an efficient-attention method, but for video generation rather than LLM inference, so borderline.

records.title: CAM: Asynchronous GPU-Initiated, CPU-Managed SSD Management for Batching Storage Access
records.reason: CAM lets GPUs initiate and manage NVMe SSD accesses asynchronously with CPU-managed batching to remove kernel overhead in accelerator-centric systems; generic GPU storage infrastructure that could serve inference data paths but is not inference-specific, hence borderline.

records.title: Cortex: Workflow-Aware Resource Pooling and Scheduling for Agentic Serving
records.reason: Cortex is a workflow-aware agentic serving platform that isolates per-stage resource pools, improving KV cache utilization, throughput and predictability for LLM agent workloads; a direct LLM serving/scheduling contribution.

records.title: Flover: A Temporal Fusion Framework for Efficient Autoregressive Model Parallel Inference
records.reason: Flover temporally fuses weight loading across tokens in model-parallel autoregressive inference, reducing the repeated full-model weight loads that dominate sequential generation; a direct inference execution optimization.

records.title: Accelerating Machine Learning Systems via Category Theory: Applications to Spherical Attention for Gene Regulatory Networks
records.reason: Category-theory neural circuit diagrams are used to guide compilation, with the concrete application being spherical attention for gene regulatory networks; a genomics application with no LLM inference contribution.

records.title: Efficient 1D Grouped Convolution for PyTorch a Case Study: Fast On-Device Fine-Tuning for SqueezeBERT
records.reason: This ASAP paper improves 1D grouped convolution memory management for on-device fine-tuning of SqueezeBERT; the work targets training/fine-tuning cost on edge GPUs, not inference execution.

records.title: Efficient Sparse Processing-in-Memory Architecture (ESPIM) for Machine Learning Inference
records.reason: ESPIM is a sparse processing-in-memory architecture for memory-bandwidth-bound matrix-vector inference in ML models including transformers, tackling irregular sparse inference load imbalance in PIM hardware; a direct inference architecture contribution.

records.title: Mind the Gap: Assessing Temporal Generalization in Neural Language Models
records.reason: This study evaluates how Transformer-XL language models degrade when predicting text from future time periods; a temporal generalization evaluation with no inference-system mechanism.

records.title: A Survey of Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Customized Large Language Models
records.reason: This survey covers graph retrieval-augmented generation for customizing LLMs, organizing retrieval structures used at inference time, but it is a survey of a RAG application area without a new serving or decoding mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: HeartMuLa: A Family of Open Sourced Music Foundation Models
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a family of music foundation models for music understanding and generation, an audio-content application domain, with no inference-system subject in the title.

records.title: One Token Is Enough: Improving Diffusion Language Models with a Sink Token
records.reason: A fixed sink token is proposed to stabilize the moving-sink phenomenon in diffusion language models during parallel generation; it concerns generation stability of an alternative LM paradigm rather than serving or decoding efficiency, hence borderline.

records.title: BayLing-Duplex: Native Full-Duplex Speech Dialogue with a Single Autoregressive LLM
records.reason: BayLing-Duplex builds a native full-duplex speech dialogue model on a single autoregressive LLM without external VAD; real-time interaction architecture for speech, adjacent to inference but primarily a speech-model capability contribution, so borderline.

records.title: CirrusBench: Evaluating LLM-based Agents Beyond Correctness in Real-World Cloud Service Environments
records.reason: CirrusBench benchmarks LLM agents on real cloud-service customer cases beyond correctness, including resolution efficiency; an agent evaluation benchmark with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: When Agents Slow Down: Understanding LLM Agents'Test-Time Strategies via Elo-per-token Analysis
records.reason: Elo-per-token analysis measures how LLM agents allocate test-time compute across long trajectories; an analysis/evaluation methodology for agent behavior, not an inference system or efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Liberating LLM Capabilities in Full-Duplex Speech Models
records.reason: This work restructures full-duplex speech models so text-native outputs such as code and structured analysis remain first-class alongside speech; a capability/output-modality contribution without an inference-system mechanism.

records.title: SEAR: Schema-Based Evaluation and Routing for LLM Gateways
records.reason: SEAR defines a schema for evaluating production LLM responses and routing requests across multi-provider gateways using latency, cost and throughput signals; gateway routing infrastructure, but centered on evaluation data modeling rather than a serving mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Ultra‐Wide‐Field Noninvasive Imaging Through Scattering Media Via Physics‐Guided Deep Learning
records.reason: Title explicitly limits the work to noninvasive imaging through scattering media via deep learning, an optical-imaging application, with no language-model or inference-system subject in the title.

records.title: MOSAIC: More LLMs, Less Cost through Collaborative Reasoning for Compiler Optimizations
records.reason: MOSAIC coordinates multiple LLMs collaboratively to cut the query cost of LLM-guided compiler optimization; multi-model cost routing demonstrated on a compiler application rather than a general inference system, hence borderline.

records.title: SeqRoute: Global Budget-Aware Sequential LLM Routing via Offline Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: SeqRoute formulates multi-turn LLM routing under a global budget as an MDP solved by offline RL, preventing early budget exhaustion across a session; a routing policy contribution adjacent to serving economics, but no serving-system mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Restoring the Sweet Spot: Pass-Rate Weighted Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
records.reason: Pass-rate weighted self-distillation modifies SDPO reinforcement learning so advantages concentrate on intermediate-difficulty questions; an RL training method for reasoning capability, not inference efficiency.

records.title: A Review on Event-Augmented, Audio-Visual Distillation for MicroLip-Reading with Tiny Transformers
records.reason: This review surveys event-camera and audio-visual distillation approaches for micro-lip-reading with tiny transformers; a sensing application review with no LLM inference-system content.

records.title: Evaluating and Achieving Controllable Code Completion in Code LLM
records.reason: C3-Bench benchmarks instruction-following controllability in code LLM completion and related methods; primarily an evaluation contribution for a coding capability, not an inference system.

records.title: Improve Large Language Model Systems with User Logs
records.reason: This work learns continually from noisy real-world user interaction logs to improve deployed LLM systems; a post-deployment training/data paradigm rather than an inference execution or serving contribution.

records.title: The Transformer as a Polar State Estimator
records.reason: The transformer block is re-derived as a polar-coordinate state estimator where attention aggregates directional evidence and normalization enforces a hyperspherical constraint; a theoretical reinterpretation with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Can We Optimize the Performance-Carbon Emission Break-Even Point?: The Quest for Greener LLMs
records.reason: A differentiable carbon surrogate is folded into the fine-tuning loss to seek accuracy gains at near-zero inference carbon cost; the mechanism is a training objective, so the inference benefit is indirect and unproven as a system contribution, hence unrelated under the training-only freeze.

records.title: LSTM-Style Looped Transformers with Shared KV Caches
records.reason: An LSTM-style looped transformer shares one KV cache across its recurrent core, cutting persistent cache sets from fifteen to four at matched FLOPs; cache sharing is inference-relevant, but the paper is an architecture study trained and evaluated as a model design, so borderline.
